items.note: The teal profile band sits above an outlined form card. A grey summary strip with a red icon at the top of the card reads 'Fix the highlighted fields, then save again.' The empty name field has an ink border with the pink focus halo, the email field has a red border, and each field has its own red icon and message. One pink 'Save changes' button and a ghost Reset sit below.

The same layout on a black ground with a raised dark card. The focused name field has a pink halo, the invalid email field a red border, and each error is an icon plus a sentence that stays readable on dark. One pink save button with a paper-outlined ghost Reset beside it.

The band collapses to a breadcrumb, title and sticker icon, followed by a scrolling pill strip whose current tab is ink. The form is one column. The error summary box sits at the top, both field errors appear in full under their inputs, and Save and Reset sit in the flow at the bottom. Nothing is clipped.
The confirmation is now an inline 'Saved' check next to Reset, so nothing covers the action row as the toast did before. The pink 'Save changes' button shows the hard offset lift with its ink shadow.
On dark, the inline pink check with 'Saved' text sits to the right of the paper-outlined Reset. The save button is fully visible, and the form card stays a raised surface on the black ground.
At phone width, the lifted pink save button, Reset and the 'Saved' check fit on one row at the bottom of the card. No pinned toast covers the buttons, so the earlier overlap is gone.

A raised dialog with an ink border and hard offset shadow sits over the plan cards. It has the title 'Switch to the Business plan?', one sentence, a ghost Cancel and a pink 'Confirm change', with an outlined close button at top right. The scrim stops above the invoices table. That looks like a fixed, viewport-sized layer in a full-page capture, not something a person would see.

On dark, the dialog is a raised dark panel with a light border and the light hard shadow over a black scrim. Cancel is a paper-outlined ghost button and confirm is the only pink action. Pink price tags stay visible behind the scrim as tags, not actions.

At 390px, the dialog spans the content width with its hard shadow, a wrapped title, a close button, and full-width Cancel and pink 'Confirm change' side by side. The scrim covers the viewport-height slice around it, again a fixed-layer capture effect. The stacked invoice rows below are intact.

The security band stays teal, the same as the other settings tabs, so the earlier per-tab color change is fixed. The change-password card shows a red-outlined summary strip, a green 'Strength: Strong' hint, a red-bordered confirm field and 'Passwords do not match.' with an icon. One pink 'Update password' button sits above the outlined sessions table, whose Revoke buttons are ghost.

In dark mode, the summary strip has a dark-red outline and the confirm field has a pink halo, with the mismatch message under it. One pink update button. The sessions table keeps a light outline with paper-outlined Revoke buttons and readable rows.

At phone width, the error summary, the mismatch message and the pink update button all fit in the card. The sessions reflow into stacked blocks whose Revoke buttons keep full width and padding, right-aligned. The earlier collapsed buttons are fixed.

Focus sits on the ink 'Notifications' pill in the side nav. It shows the 2px focus outline at an offset that follows the pill shape. The page has the teal band with a '3 of 6 notifications on' status pill and two outlined cards of On/Off switches, each with a text label.

On dark, the current pill is paper-filled and has a pink focus outline at an offset that stands out clearly against black. The switch cards are raised dark panels with On/Off text next to each switch.

In the mobile pill strip, the focused ink 'Notifications' pill has a visible offset ring. The band's status pill and the stacked switch rows, each with On/Off text, are readable, and nothing scrolls sideways.
